lines.en: Toe to ground, as if walking on fire.

lines.zh: 我走得不高傲，只是习惯。
lines.en: My walk isn't arrogance. Just habit.

lines.zh: 每一步都踏出王的架子。
lines.en: Every step carries a prince's bearing.
Hands behind my back, temper held in.

lines.zh: 这道影子跟着我，太像他。
lines.en: This shadow follows me — too much like him.
Heels land and sand scatters.

lines.zh: 我不看路边，路自己让开。
lines.en: I don't look aside. The road makes way.
Circling you — weighing you up.
One corner of my cape flips behind.

lines.zh: 我走一圈，你就该紧张了。
lines.en: One lap from me and you should be tense.
Not fast, but pressure enough.
Chin up, I walk past.
Arms crossed, I watch you.

lines.zh: 这具克隆的骄傲是真的。
lines.en: The pride in this clone is genuine.
Deciding whether you're worth my effort.
There's a faint tremor at my aura's edge.

lines.zh: 我的发际线在风里不动。
lines.en: My hairline doesn't move in the wind.
Not worth the breath to say it.
I scan the surroundings with a corner eye.

lines.zh: 这具身体记得战斗的节奏。
lines.en: This body remembers the rhythm.
Standing straight is a matter of attitude.
I hold my ki in, keep it from leaking.
No one deserves an explanation.
Silence is a prince's courtesy.

lines.zh: 这壳子的力量，勉强够用。
lines.en: This shell's power is barely adequate.

lines.zh: 你在我面前站着，有点胆子。
lines.en: Standing in front of me takes nerve.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在躲，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes are dodging; I noticed.
Your aura's like a guttering candle.
I can't be bothered to argue.
I flick my cape; you are still standing?
That doesn't mean you're safe.
Your stance is slovenly.

lines.zh: 我见过比你强一百倍的。
lines.en: I've seen a hundred stronger than you.

lines.zh: 说点有意义的，否则走开。
lines.en: Say something worth hearing, or leave.
You're standing in my way.

lines.zh: 我讨厌别人打量我的脸。
lines.en: I hate being studied.
That confidence is fake.
I've already noted you.
You're deciding whether to kneel.
I'm tired of that expression.
What — still want a try?
This body actually feels pain.
You actually touched me.
The wound burns. I press it.
My ki faltered for a moment.
This shell still holds.
Pain is a reminder, not a weakness.
I stand straight. Don't make me repeat.

lines.zh: 这点伤还不够资格杀我。
lines.en: That wound isn't enough to kill me.

lines.zh: 你觉得我会为食物低头？
lines.en: Think I'd bow my head for food?
Set it down, then get lost.
That's beneath me.
I am hungry. Not now.
Don't try to win me with food.
This body needs no charity.
I can smell it's cheap stuff.

lines.zh: 你要是敢笑，我立刻动手。
lines.en: Laugh and I strike immediately.
Keep it and eat it yourself.

lines.zh: 我打猎的时候你还没出生。
lines.en: I hunted before you were born.
You just touched me.
Back off. That's not a request.

lines.zh: 你以为撞我就能让我动？
lines.en: You think bumping me moves me?
My balance is steadier than you think.
Stop crowding me from behind.
You can't shift me half a step.
Try that once more.
Petty moves like that disgust me.
Clear out. Three breaths.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子不谈这个。
lines.en: A Saiyan prince doesn't discuss that.
I have no interest in that.

lines.zh: 这具克隆身体不配谈家。
lines.en: A cloned body has no claim to a family.
Don't insult me with that.
I care about power.
My bloodline ends with me.
Quiet. Change the topic.
I've nothing to leave anyone.
Say that to someone else.
I don't stoop for refuse.
This stone will do.
Throw it here. Don't make me wait.
A coin? Not worth it.
I picked it up. That's all.
This was never my task.
A sharp stone on the ground.
Only because it was there.
You dropped it. You pick it up.

lines.zh: 我拿了，你不会有意见吧。
lines.en: I'm taking it. You have no objection.
Finally, you stand up.

lines.zh: 锁定，别让我的耐心白费。
lines.en: Marked. Don't waste my patience.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作你看见了吗。
lines.en: Did you see my hand lift?
That trickle of ki isn't enough.
Fine. You'll be my opponent.
I move first. Don't regret it.
Your position is naive.
I've marked your center.
I'll end this in one strike.
Ready yourself. I won't strike twice.
Your weapon's raised too high.
Then I'll start with you.
Stand still, let me see your face.
Consider this a sign of respect.
I dislike long fights.
Retreating is smart of you.
Ki is gathering. Don't interrupt.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸已经出卖你了。
lines.en: Your breathing betrayed you.
The sand under you will slip.
Flashy moves burn the most ki.
I hold back, waiting for the moment.
Rock behind you — no way out.

lines.zh: 再往左一步，就进我范围。
lines.en: One step left and you're in range.
Your wind-up is too slow.
I don't need to watch your hands.
You've started to sweat.
One strike. Only one.

lines.zh: 你的影子出卖了你的动作。
lines.en: Your shadow gives your moves away.
I'm at the perfect range.
Don't count on me being careless.
This body's ki is sufficient.
Catch this fist properly!
You can't keep up with my speed.
This leg sweeps your base.
Here's the ki blast — don't blink.
Coming down from above!
You blocked once. And twice?
Your armor won't stop ki.
This one — I gave it full effort.
Back off. I'm clearing the field.
Barrage. Don't try to open distance.
The strike lands at your ribs.
A backfist is faster than a palm.
I fight and calculate at once.
This move is Saiyan courtesy.

lines.zh: 你举着盾，膝盖已经弯了。
lines.en: You hold up your shield, but your knees have buckled.
No recovery. Keep pressing.

lines.zh: 又一个克隆，也配叫贝吉塔。
lines.en: Another clone, also called Vegeta.
My standing here is enough.

lines.zh: 这具躯壳继承了那股傲气。
lines.en: This shell inherited the arrogance.
I brush my cape with one hand.

lines.zh: 气从体内涌起，压住四周。
lines.en: Ki rises and presses on everything.

lines.zh: 有人把我从静默中拽出来。
lines.en: Someone dragged me out of stillness.
I open my eyes and look at the sky first.
This place is far too small.
Dust scatters where my feet land.

lines.zh: 我抬头，没人配与我平视。
lines.en: I look up. No one meets my eyes.
Waking, the first thing is a fist.
This power is barely acceptable.

lines.zh: 我扫了一眼，全是弱小的东西。
lines.en: One sweep of the eye — all things weak.

lines.zh: 影子先立起来，然后是我。
lines.en: The shadow rises first, then me.
I need no introduction.
I've seen this sky before.
I straighten and pull the ki in.

lines.zh: 让我看看这里有什么值得打。
lines.en: Let's see what's worth fighting here.

lines.zh: 火焰舔过我的披风边缘。
lines.en: Fire licks the edge of my cape.
I twisted my ankle on landing.
Water seals my mouth — ki is useless.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的气流推了我。
lines.en: The blast's wind shoved me.
Something sharp bit my shoulder.
That spell means to command me.
An empty stomach spoils my focus.
Lightning ran from crown to sole.

lines.zh: 我落下去，连气都抓不住。
lines.en: I'm falling. Even ki can't grip.
